project: ADAS ECU Automated Validation & Test Harness

mappings.description: System SHALL read Lidar position data (x, y) from CAN ID 0x100
System SHALL read Radar velocity data (vx, vy) from CAN ID 0x200
Sensor task SHALL execute with 10ms period (100 Hz)
System SHALL implement Kalman filter for 2D position and velocity
State vector SHALL contain [x, y, vx, vy]
Watchdog SHALL monitor compute task execution time
System SHALL enforce 50ms deadline for compute task
System SHALL trigger emergency brake on deadline violation
System SHALL enter SAFE state on deadline violation
Queue overflow SHALL not cause system failure
CAN errors SHALL not crash sensor task
Emergency brake SHALL activate within 10ms of violation
